        bw = max_c - min_c + 1

            s += 1

            cc = c - min_c
            pts = [
                (rr, cc),
                (rr, s - 1 - cc),
                (s - 1 - rr, cc),
                (s - 1 - rr, s - 1 - cc),
            ]
            for pr, pc in pts:
                if 0 <= pr < s and 0 <= pc < s:
                    layer[pr][pc] = color

        layers.append((s, color, layer))

    S = max(s for s, _, _ in layers)
